overview: 本期共收录 11 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、金融科技（2 篇）、行为金融（1 篇）。方法上以均衡模型、回归分析为主。来源分布：arXiv（9 篇）、OpenAlex（1 篇）、Semantic Scholar（1 篇）。

papers.title: Prospective evaluation of automated KU F40 fecal analysis versus microscopy for intestinal protozoa and illustrative labor costs
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Stool ova-and-parasite (O&P) microscopy remains widely used but is labor-intensive and constrained by expert availability. AI-assisted automated fecal analyzers can digitize stool microscopy workflows and generate images that may support remote expert review; however, evaluations should distinguish algorithm-only output from clinically deployable workflows that incorporate human verification. In a prospective diagnostic study at a tertiary-care parasitology laboratory in Izmir, Türkiye (November 2024–October 2025), 1000 consecutive, unselected adult human stool specimens submitted for routine testing were assessed in parallel by routine microscopy and the KU-F40 automated fecal analyzer. All 1,000 specimens contributed paired entries to the analysis tables. KU-F40 was evaluated as automated diagnosis (AD; algorithm call before human review) and AD plus expert user verification (AD + UV; expert review of KU-F40-generated images). The diagnostic AD + UV analysis was kept distinct from the labor-cost model, which evaluated illustrative 30%-verification and universal-verification scenarios. Relative to routine microscopy, KU-F40 AD showed positive/negative percent agreement (PPA/NPA) of 100%/99.8% for
                    Entamoeba histolytica/dispar
                    , 100%/98.6% for
                    Giardia spp
                    ., and 67.3%/97.7% for
                    Blastocystis
                    spp. Expert verification removed the 14 microscopy-negative
                    Giardia
                    AD calls and reduced microscopy-negative
                    Blastocystis
                    calls from 22 to 12; the two microscopy-negative E. histolytica/dispar calls remained UV-supported but were not independently adjudicated. Coccidia (
                    Cryptosporidium
                    spp.,
                    Cyclospora cayetanensis
                    ) fell outside the KU-F40 classifier panel and were identified only by conventional microscopy. The illustrative labor model assumed 35 min/specimen for microscopy and 2 min/specimen for AD, with 10 min of specialist time per verified specimen; no formal time-and-motion study was performed. The resulting modeled direct labor costs (USD/specimen) for microscopy, AD and illustrative 30%-verification AD + UV were Türkiye 4.56/0.20/0.72, Germany 21.87/0.91/3.46 and UK 27.21/0.79/4.66. KU-F40 provided a digitized screening workflow. Under the specified assumptions, the illustrative labor model yielded lower estimated hands-on labor inputs and direct labor costs than conventional microscopy; these were model outputs, not observed operational performance. Expert verification improved agreement for selected organisms, but UV-supported discordant calls were not an independent confirmation of infection. KU-F40 did not cover Cryptosporidium or Cyclospora in this evaluation; conventional and dedicated methods therefore remain necessary whenever these organisms fall within the requested diagnostic scope. Multi-site studies with measured workflow times and independent discordance adjudication are required before implementation or cost-effectiveness claims.
papers.summary_zh:
【行为金融】摘要

粪便卵和寄生虫（O&P）显微镜检查仍被广泛使用，但该过程劳动强度较高，且受限于专业人员的可用性。基于人工智能的自动化粪便分析仪能够实现粪便显微镜检查工作的数字化，并生成可用于远程专家审核的图像；然而，在进行评估时，需要区分仅由算法生成的结果与结合了人工验证的临床可用流程。在土耳其伊兹密尔的一家三级护理寄生虫学实验室进行的一项前瞻性诊断研究中（2024年11月至2025年10月），共对1000份连续提交的成人粪便样本进行了常规显微镜检查和KU-F40自动化粪便分析仪的并行检测。所有样本均被纳入分析数据表中。KU-F40的分析模式包括两种：仅依赖算法的自动化诊断（AD，即算法生成结果后无需人工审核）以及结合专家审核的自动化诊断（AD+UV，即专家对KU-F40生成的图像进行审核）。本研究将AD+UV模式与劳动成本模型进行了区分，后者评估了30%验证率和100%验证率两种情况。与常规显微镜检查相比，KU-F40在以下病原体的检测中显示出较高的阳性/阴性一致率：溶组织内阿米巴（Entamoeba histolytica）/迪斯帕内阿米巴（Dispar）为100%/99.8%，贾第...。

papers.title: Deceleration without identification: testing a power-law trend in Bitcoin prices under persistent noise
papers.abstract: Plotted against time since its first block on logarithmic axes, the price of Bitcoin lies close to a straight line, and a power law in time has been proposed as its long-run trend. A good fit is weak evidence: when deviations from a trend are as persistent as a random walk, regressions on time find trends and high $R^2$ where none exist. We first bound what fifteen years of weekly prices can reveal, then test only what is answerable. Using a few low-frequency averages, invariant to the noise scale and calibrated over a declared family of persistent deviations with a four-year cycle and declining volatility, we test constant drift in expected log price against an added log-age term. The procedure was fixed, validated and publicly hashed before it was applied once. Constant drift is rejected under this family at nominal 5%, and a log-age coefficient of 5.7, close to the published exponent, is not rejected. The rejection does not survive allowing persistence beyond a random walk, and a Gompertz curve with a ceiling fits about as well as the power law. Whether deviations revert to the trend cannot be decided. Registered forecasts for 2027-2030 will be scored by future prices.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】将比特币价格随时间的变化情况在对数坐标轴上绘制出来后，其走势接近一条直线；因此有研究提出比特币价格在长期内遵循幂律分布。然而，这种拟合结果并不十分可靠：当价格偏离趋势的情况与随机游走现象一样持续时，基于时间的回归分析往往会“发现”趋势，并得出较高的$R^2$值（即拟合优度），但实际上这些趋势并不存在。首先，我们分析了十五年来的每周价格数据所能揭示的信息；随后，我们仅验证那些能够通过合理解释的结论。通过使用一些对噪声尺度具有不变性的低频平均值，并根据一组具有四年周期和逐渐下降波动性的持续价格偏差数据进行校准，我们对比了“预期对数价格存在恒定漂移”与“对数价格随时间增长”这两种模型。该分析方法在应用前已经经过固定、验证并公开发布。在该数据集下，恒定漂移假设在5%的显著性水平上被拒绝；而一个对数年龄系数为5.7的模型（接近已公布的幂律指数）并未被拒绝。不过，如果允许价格偏离趋势的情况超过随机游走的范畴，这种拟合结果就不成立；此时，Gompertz曲线（具有上限约束）的拟合效果与幂律模型相当。目前尚无法确定价格偏差是否会最终回归到长期趋势。关于2027至2030年的预测结果，将需要通过未...。研究方法：回归分析、模型校准。

papers.title: Backtesting High-Dimensional Expected Shortfall
papers.abstract: Forecast evaluation increasingly uses high-dimensional predictors, but estimation and regularization of large predictive models can distort conventional backtests. This issue is particularly important for forecasting downside risk, where the signal-to-noise ratio is low. We develop out-of-sample Expected Shortfall (ES) backtests that remove the large first-order bias effects of estimating high-dimensional Value-at-Risk, ES, and the evaluation instrument. In a linear ES specification, the proposed methods are easily implemented as Double Lasso with a tail-size-adjusted score as a generated dependent variable. More generally, we characterize orthogonal ES backtesting moments, and establish oracle equivalence and valid inference under time-series dependence and repeated estimation with overlapping and expanding training windows. Simulations show that conventional backtests can severely overreject ES optimal forecasts, whereas orthogonalization improves size control. An application to downside-growth forecasting for G7 economies finds evidence against a US growth-only ES specification, even though forecast-oriented regularization selects no additional financial predictors. The application also shows that accounting for estimation can change rejection decisions in either direction. These findings highlight the distinct roles of predictive variable selection and backtesting in the evaluation of high-dimensional tail-risk models.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】预测评估越来越多地使用高维预测变量，但大型预测模型的估计和正则化过程可能会扭曲传统的回测结果。这一问题在预测下行风险时尤为突出，因为这种情况下的信噪比较低。我们提出了一种基于样本外数据的预期亏损（Expected Shortfall, ES）回测方法，该方法能够消除在估计高维风险价值（Value-at-Risk, VaR）及评估指标时产生的较大的一阶偏差效应。在线性ES模型框架下，所提出的方法可以通过使用调整尾部大小的得分作为生成因变量来轻松实现（即通过双Lasso算法）。更一般地，我们研究了正交化ES回测的统计特性，并在存在时间序列依赖性以及训练窗口重叠或扩展的情况下，证明了模型的“神谕等价性”（oracle equivalence）和有效推断性。模拟结果表明，传统回测方法可能会严重误判最优预测结果，而正交化技术能够有效改善统计量的显著性控制。通过对G7经济体的下行增长预测进行应用，我们发现即使在不添加额外金融预测变量的情况下，基于美国经济增长的ES模型也无法准确解释实际数据；同时，正交化处理还可能改变模型的拒绝决策方向。这些发现强调了预测变量选择与回测方法在评估高维尾部风险模...。研究方法：数值模拟、LASSO 正则化。

papers.title: How Does Digital Industry Agglomeration Drive High-Quality Urban Development? An Analysis from Both Geographic and Virtual Perspectives
papers.venue: Journal of Economics and Public Finance
papers.abstract: In the digital economy era, the spatial organization of digital industry is evolving from geographic agglomeration to virtual-real integration, becoming a key driver of high-quality urban development. Using panel data from 30 provincial capital cities in China from 2013 to 2023, this paper examines the impact of digital industrial agglomeration on high-quality urban development from the dual perspectives of geographic agglomeration and virtual agglomeration. The results show that: (1) Both digital industry geographic agglomeration and virtual agglomeration significantly promote high-quality urban development, and geographic agglomeration presents an inverted-U relationship, first promoting and then inhibiting. (2) The impact of the two types of agglomeration has significant regional heterogeneity and agglomeration-level heterogeneity. Both types of agglomeration have their strongest promoting effect in the eastern region. Cities with low agglomeration levels mainly rely on scale expansion and digital capacity to accumulate and release potential. In contrast, cities with high agglomeration levels rely more on deepening innovation and optimizing spatial structure. (3) Both types of agglomeration have significant positive spatial spillover effects, which can promote the high-quality development of surrounding cities; however, when geographic agglomeration crosses the threshold, its spillover will be weakened. The conclusions of this paper provide policy implications for optimizing the spatial layout of the digital industry and promoting regional coordinated development.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】在数字经济时代，数字产业的空间组织模式正从地理集聚向虚实融合转变，成为推动高质量城市发展的关键因素。本文利用2013至2023年中国30个省会城市的面板数据，从地理集聚和虚拟集聚两个维度探讨了数字产业集聚对高质量城市发展的影响。研究结果表明：（1）数字产业的地理集聚和虚拟集聚均显著促进了高质量城市发展，其中地理集聚呈现出“倒U”关系，即初期具有促进作用，后期则产生抑制效应；（2）这两种集聚方式的影响存在显著的区域差异和集聚水平差异，东部地区的促进效应最为显著。集聚水平较低的城市主要依靠规模扩张和数字能力来释放发展潜力，而集聚水平较高的城市则更注重深化创新和优化空间结构；（3）这两种集聚方式均具有显著的正空间溢出效应，能够带动周边城市的高质量发展，但当地理集聚达到一定阈值后，其溢出效应会减弱。本文的结论为优化数字产业的空间布局和促进区域协调发展提供了政策启示。。研究方法：面板数据。

papers.title: Economic Benefits of Cross-Border Electricity Trade and Domestic Electricity Production in Switzerland
papers.abstract: This paper assesses the economic benefits of cross-border electricity trade in the context of rising energy prices and geopolitical uncertainty. Switzerland provides a particularly compelling case because of its geographical location and limited integration into the EU electricity market. We first use the Nexus-e framework to simulate the generation capacity and transmission grid expansion required under autarky and free-trade scenarios. Based on these capacity configurations, a fundamental power market model simulates wholesale market outcomes under projected demand and generation conditions for 2040. By jointly accounting for consumer and producer surplus, as well as investments in generation capacity and grid infrastructure, we provide a comprehensive assessment of the welfare effects of cross-border electricity trade, leading to an estimated EUR 1.5 billion gain. More specifically, open access to cross-border electricity trade implies a EUR 1.8 billion transfer from largely publicly owned producers to consumers. Finally, we provide an illustrative, non-causal mapping of broader macroeconomic effects. Under a price-convergence assumption, the implied demand adjustment corresponds to a GDP-equivalent effect of approximately EUR 7 billion.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】本文在能源价格上涨和地缘政治不确定性加剧的背景下，评估了跨境电力贸易的经济效益。瑞士因其地理位置以及与欧盟电力市场的有限融合程度，成为一个尤为具有代表性的案例。我们首先利用Nexus-e框架模拟了在自给自足和自由贸易两种情景下所需的发电能力和输电网扩建情况。基于这些容量配置，一个基础性的电力市场模型模拟了2040年在预期需求和发电条件下的批发市场结果。通过综合考虑消费者和生产者的剩余收益，以及发电能力和电网基础设施的投资，我们对跨境电力贸易的福利效应进行了全面评估，估计其带来的收益为15亿欧元。更具体地说，开放跨境电力贸易意味着从主要由公有制企业主导的生产者向消费者转移了18亿欧元的利益。最后，我们提供了一个说明性的、非因果关系的宏观经济效应分析框架。在价格趋同的假设下，由此引发的需求调整相当于约70亿欧元的GDP增长效应。。

papers.title: Nonzero-Sum Stochastic Exit Games with Singular Belief Dynamics
papers.abstract: We study a two-player nonzero-sum stochastic exit game with asymmetric information. Each firm chooses the time to exit a duopoly and, conditional on remaining active, when to exit a monopoly. The asymmetry stems from privately observed exit values, while profit flows are driven by a general one-dimensional diffusion. Allowing for exit from monopoly induces singular dynamics of the associated belief process, so we construct it as a limit of regular approximations. The underlying dynamics are not described by a system of SDEs, which requires a new mathematical approach. We construct a symmetric Nash equilibrium in which the duopoly exit is a hitting time of the belief process while the monopoly exit is described through the underlying diffusion. Our equilibrium exhibits novel phenomena: the market may be abandoned by both firms in finite time (market collapse), and firms with heterogeneous exit values may optimally exit simultaneously (clustering). These features are absent when monopoly is always preferred to exit.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了一个具有非对称信息的双玩家非零和随机退出博弈。每家公司都选择退出双头垄断的时间，并在继续参与竞争的条件下，决定何时退出垄断市场。信息不对称性源于各公司能够私下观察到自己的退出价值，而利润流则受到一维扩散过程的影响。允许退出垄断市场会导致相关信念过程出现特殊动态，因此我们通过常规逼近方法来构建这一过程。该过程的本质特征无法用随机微分方程（SDEs）来描述，这需要采用新的数学方法。我们构建了一个对称的纳什均衡：在均衡状态下，双头垄断的退出时刻是信念过程的一个到达时刻，而垄断市场的退出则由潜在的扩散过程来决定。我们的均衡模型揭示了一些新颖现象：两家公司可能在有限时间内同时退出市场（市场崩溃）；或者具有不同退出价值的公司可能会选择同时退出（市场聚集）。当垄断市场始终是更优的退出选择时，这些现象不会出现。。研究方法：随机过程、均衡模型。

papers.title: Optimal Regulation and Information Institutions with Hidden Network Equilibria
papers.abstract: Aggregate outcomes can conceal network configurations that expose households to uninsurable risk and require different public services. We study a regulator's joint choice of a corrective activity charge and an information institution in a two-population network game. Although aggregate behavior follows an exact stable law, distinct specialization equilibria require different targeted interventions. With purchased Gaussian monitoring, primitive conditions imply a discontinuous switch between strong regulation without purchased information and informed specialization. The regulator may alternatively obtain signed certification or elicit a privately known state through a report backed by committed random audits. We characterize the three institutions' optimized values and the cost thresholds at which credible disclosure replaces government monitoring. The institutional choice also changes optimal regulation: even when certification and truthful reporting reveal the same state, costly audits favor less specialization and a higher corrective charge. This ordering and monotonicity in audit costs hold under an explicit interiority condition without global concavity of the audit problem. The institutional comparison is solved in the benchmark without feedback from anticipated policy, while the policy switch and strict institutional rankings admit local persistence under additional regularity conditions. Results depend on enforceable verification, restrictions on data access, and an explicitly limited institutional menu.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】总体结果可能会掩盖某些网络配置，这些配置使家庭面临无法通过保险覆盖的风险，并需要不同的公共服务。我们研究了一个监管机构在包含两个群体的网络博弈中，如何同时选择纠正性措施的费用和信息提供机制。尽管总体行为遵循一个精确的稳定法则，但不同的专业化均衡需要不同的针对性干预措施。在购买高斯监控服务的情况下，基本条件表明：在没有购买信息的情况下，会从严格的监管转向有针对性的专业化；而在购买了信息后，则会从有针对性的专业化转向更严格的监管。监管机构还可以通过要求提供有签名的认证文件，或者通过承诺进行随机审计来获取私人掌握的信息。我们分析了这三种机制的最优价值，以及可信信息披露能够替代政府监管的成本阈值。制度选择也会影响最优监管措施：即使认证和真实报告揭示的是相同的信息，高昂的审计成本也会导致更低的专业化程度和更高的纠正性费用。这种排序关系以及审计成本的单调性，在审计问题不存在全局凹性的情况下依然成立（即在不依赖内部性条件的情况下）。在没有预期政策反馈的基准模型中，我们可以解决这些制度间的比较问题；而在存在额外规则性条件的情况下，政策转变和严格的制度排名则可能导致局部持续性。研究结果还受到可执行...。

papers.title: Herding with Multiple States: When the Prior Matters
papers.abstract: In sequential observational learning with more than two states, the same information structure and preferences can yield learning for some full-support priors and herding for others. This disproves a conjecture of Kartik, Lee, Liu, and Rappoport (2024, working-paper version). In the counterexample, the cascade region has nonempty interior, yet learning occurs for generic full-support priors outside it. Focusing on information and preferences, we introduce two necessary conditions for learning. Escapability requires that signals can provide arbitrarily strong evidence that any given action is ex post suboptimal; pairwise escapability is its pairwise variant. If escapability fails, herding occurs for some initial prior; if pairwise escapability fails, it occurs for every full-support prior. For a class of environments with interval optimality and monotone likelihood ratios, escapability completely characterizes learning and herding independently of the full-support initial prior. With location-shift signals, this characterization reduces to pairwise distinguishability, a generalization of unbounded beliefs (Smith and Sørensen, 2000).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在具有两个以上状态的顺序观察学习中，相同的 정보 구조와 선호도가 일부 경우에는 학습을 유도하고, 다른 경우에는 군집 행동을 유발할 수 있다. 이는 Kartik, Lee, Liu, Rappoport (2024, 워킹페이퍼 버전)의 추측을 반박하는 결과이다. 반례에서는 캐스케이드 영역의 내부가 비어 있음에도 불구하고, 그 외부에 위치한 일반적인 전체 지지 초기 확률 분포에서도 학습이 발생한다. 정보와 선호도에 초점을 맞추어, 우리는 학습이 일어나기 위한 두 가지 필수 조건을 제시한다. “탈출 가능성(escapability)”이란 신호들이 특정 행동이 사후적으로 최적이 아님을 임의로 강력하게 증명할 수 있어야 함을 의미하며, “쌍별 탈출 가능성(pairwise escapability)”은 이러한 탈출 가능성의 쌍별 형태이다. 탈출 가능성이 만족되지 않으면 일부 초기 확률 분포에서 군집 행동이 발생하며, 쌍별 탈출 가능성도 만족되지 않으면 모든 전체 지지 초기 확률 분포에서 군집 행동이 ...。

papers.title: Optimal Trading Speed on Blockchain
papers.abstract: On blockchain-based exchanges, faster blocks weaken the priority-fee competition among arbitrageurs and shift rents from the block producer to them. Equilibrium liquidity peaks at an interior block speed; beyond a threshold, an active liquidity provider cream-skims and passive capital shrinks. Evidence from the Base Flashblocks upgrade, a tenfold block-speed increase, confirms the predictions. Priority-fee bids decrease sharply and arbitrageurs' net profit rises. The active liquidity provider rebalances faster, avoids toxic flow, and earns a higher profit. Pool depth falls and effective spreads widen despite closer tracking of external prices.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】在基于区块链的交易所中，更快的区块生成速度削弱了套利者之间的优先费竞争机制，使得租金从区块生产者手中转移到了套利者手中。当区块生成速度达到某一临界值时，市场流动性达到峰值；超过这一阈值后，活跃的流动性提供者会获取大部分收益，而被动资本则会减少。Base Flashblocks升级（区块生成速度提升了十倍）的相关数据证实了这些预测：优先费出价大幅下降，套利者的净利润上升。活跃的流动性提供者能够更快地调整策略，避免不良交易流动，并获得更高的利润。尽管对外部价格的跟踪更加紧密，但交易池的深度仍然下降，有效价差也随之扩大。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models in Financial Predictions
papers.abstract: This technical note introduces tabular foundation models (TFMs) to accounting research and evaluates their performance in one common benchmark task: predicting firms' next-year earnings changes. TFMs produce numeric predictions and learn in context, without post-release training or tuning, making them natural and easy to use for forecasting. The TFMs we study are pretrained on synthetic tabular data, so they avoid look-ahead bias from memorizing firms' outcomes. We compare Google Research's TabFM with a fine-tuned open-weight large language model developed in recent accounting research and with several tree-based models. TabFM is more accurate than all comparison models. It is also faster and less computationally intensive than the large language model. Several tree-based specifications produce predictions more quickly than TabFM, so choosing between them involves a trade-off between accuracy and speed. We conclude that TFMs have promise as a new tool for forecasting in accounting and finance. However, our evaluation is based on a single benchmark task, and no class of models is likely to dominate in all settings.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本技术报告将表格基础模型（Tabular Foundation Models, TFMs）引入会计研究，并评估了它们在一种常见基准任务中的表现：预测企业下一年的收益变化。表格基础模型能够生成数值预测结果，并在无需后续训练或调整的情况下进行学习，这使得它们在预测应用中具有天然的优势且易于使用。我们研究的表格基础模型是在合成表格数据上预训练的，因此能够避免因记忆企业过往业绩而产生的“前瞻性偏差”（look-ahead bias）。我们将Google Research开发的TabFM与近期会计研究中提出的经过微调的开权重大型语言模型（open-weight large language model）以及几种基于树的模型进行了比较。结果表明，TabFM的预测准确性优于所有对比模型；同时，其运行速度更快，计算资源消耗也更少。尽管某些基于树的模型在预测速度上优于TabFM，但在选择这些模型时需要在准确性与速度之间做出权衡。我们认为，表格基础模型作为会计和金融领域的新预测工具具有广阔的应用前景。然而，我们的评估仅基于单一基准任务，因此没有一种模型能够在所有场景中都占据主导地位。。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Obvious Group Manipulations and Top Trading Cycles
papers.abstract: We introduce a group version of non-obvious manipulability, which is stronger than the original definition by Troyan and Morrill (2020) and weaker than group strategy-proofness, and study its implications in Shapley-Scarf housing markets. We provide several characterizations of the Top Trading Cycles mechanism using the new condition.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种群体层面的“非显而易见的可操作性”（non-obvious manipulability）概念，该概念比Troyan和Morrill（2020年）提出的原始定义更为严格，但比“群体策略安全性”（group strategy-proofness）的要求要宽松。我们研究了这种可操作性在Shapley-Scarf住房市场中的影响，并利用这一新定义对“顶级交易循环机制”（Top Trading Cycles mechanism）进行了多种分析。。
